identity.title: Direct mapping of the temperature and velocity gradients in discs. Imaging the vertical CO snow line around IM Lupi

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present here a framework to directly measure the altitude, velocity, and temperature of the CO layers from new high spectral (0.05 km/s) and intermediate spatial (0.4”) resolution ALMA observations

evidence.quote: IM Lupi is a M0V T Tauri star (distance of $161\pm10$ pc, (cite: Gaia16)) surrounded by a large and massive disc with an inclination of $48^\circ\pm3^\circ$

question.value: Can the altitude, velocity and temperature of the CO emitting layers of the IM Lupi disc be measured directly from ALMA channel maps, locating the vertical CO snow line?

analysis_steps.goal: Locate emission maxima along isovelocity curves and derive r, h

method.value: In each channel map, for x sampled every 0.08", find near/far-side maxima y_n,y_f; y_c=(y_f+y_n)/2; r from ellipse geometry; h=(y_c-y_star)/sin i

evidence.quote: The altitude $h$ of the orbit is derived by noting that the offset between the centre of the ellipse and the star is simply $h \sin i$

key_parameters.value: x sampled every 0.08" (~1/4 beam); star at continuum peak

claims.hypothesis: CO layer altitude can be measured model-independently from channel maps
claims.experiment: Locate emission maxima on isovelocity curves for 12CO, 13CO, C18O
claims.result: 12CO at ~65 au vs 13CO ~25 au at 200 au; exponents 1.8 and 2.1
claims.finding: First direct model-independent measurement of CO layer altitudes

evidence.quote: this is the first direct, model-independent measurement of the altitude of the CO layers

claims.hypothesis: CO is depleted in the midplane
claims.experiment: Compare lower-surface morphology with MCFOST models
claims.result: Partial depletion of ~1e-4 where T<20 K reproduces the shifted lower surface
claims.finding: CO needs to be physically depleted in the midplane

evidence.quote: we need a partial depletion of $\approx 10^{-4}$ (i.e. an abundance of $\approx 10^{-8}$) of CO where T $<$ 20 K

claims.hypothesis: The vertical CO snow line temperature can be measured directly
claims.experiment: Brightness temperature of 12CO lower surface and 13CO upper surface
claims.result: Plateau at ~21 K between 130 and 300 au

evidence.loc: 4.4 Two-dimensional temperature structure and vertical CO snow line
evidence.quote: The constant 21 K of the lower surface is consistent with the expected CO condensation temperature

claims.hypothesis: Velocity field shows vertical gradient and sub-Keplerian rotation
claims.experiment: Compare measured velocities with altitude-dependent Keplerian
claims.result: Agreement within 300 au; ~0.15 km/s deviation at 400 au
claims.finding: Pressure gradient may explain it, wind possible

evidence.loc: 4.3 Vertical velocity gradient and sub-Keplerian rotation

why_this_method.value: Intermediate-inclination discs have Keplerian velocities that spatially separate emitting regions

evidence.quote: Discs at intermediate inclinations are also ideal targets as the Keplerian velocities spatially separate the emitting regions

limitations_admitted.value: Method only valid to ~450 au and where emission is a thin layer; accuracy limited by ~0.4" resolution

evidence.quote: These conditions are met for the CO layers of IM Lupi up to a radius 450 au

evidence.quote: is not in any sense optimized and should only be considered for general guidance
